Mushmore

A non-alcoholic wellness bar for whatever mood you're in — uplift and energise, replenish and revitalise, or wind down and socialise.

What they do

About Mushmore

Mushmore is a wellness bar serving non-alcoholic, adaptogen and nootropic based beverages. Whether you want to uplift and energise, replenish and revitalise, or wind down and socialise, there's a variety of mocktails, lattes, coffees and canned beverages crafted for your needs — and so mush more.

The lineup runs through wellness brands like Almmy sparkling teas, Numuti social tonics, Vitafuel and Teelixir, with vegan, sugar-free options throughout.
